response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software developer (15+ years) with strong low-latency backend work in DLang and some C/C++ exposure at National Instruments, but the resume shows no evidence of the core requirements for this role: SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, AI accelerator or GPU architecture work, or deep-learning workload performance analysis. Education is a BSc in Computer Science with no hardware architecture specialization. While the years of experience satisfy the Bachelor's + 8 years path, the technical domain is essentially unrelated to silicon performance architecture at a principal level, so this would require a complete retraining rather than a transition.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience, including embedded and desktop
Low-latency, high-throughput systems work in DLang (async I/O, fibers, caching)
Some systems-level C/C++ experience (NI LabWindows/CVI) and strong engineering practices
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, RTL, or hardware-software co-design experience
No AI accelerator, GPU architecture, SIMD/MIMD, or DNN optimization background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack, not silicon performance architecture at principal level

key_factors.factor: Missing SoC/IP modeling and hardware architecture experience
No AI accelerator / deep-learning workload optimization background
Extensive general software engineering and low-latency systems experience
